summary: Iteration 43 — verified JWT→httpOnly-cookie migration end-to-end. All 17 pytest cases pass (login/register cookie, /auth/me via cookie only, placeholder Bearer values fall through to cookie, real Bearer still auths without cookie, logout clears cookie, customer /addresses + /search/featured, merchant /merchant/profile GET+PUT, driver PUT /drivers/status via cookie, admin impersonation replaces the cookie, Set-Cookie flags = HttpOnly+Secure+SameSite=Lax). UI flow driven through the real /login form on the preview URL also confirms: redirects to /dashboard, localStorage.token literal string 'cookie', session_token cookie httpOnly/Secure/SameSite=Lax, /api/auth/me 200 by cookie only, admin panel GETs 200 (users/orders), logout returns 200 and /auth/me then returns 401.
action_items: Optional: /api/admin/dashboard/stats returned 404 in the browser check (not related to cookie auth; admin panel appears to use different stats endpoints). Confirm intended path used by AdminPanel.
critical_code_review_comments: core.get_current_user_from_request first attempts a session_token lookup in db.users (legacy) before decoding as JWT — for cookie-only web sessions this incurs one wasted Mongo query per authenticated request. Consider decoding JWT first (that is the common path now).
server.py is >10k lines — long-standing suggestion to split into routers.
_PLACEHOLDER_TOKENS set is case-insensitive (via t.lower()) — good. Consider also stripping 'Bearer ' if the client accidentally double-prefixes.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (cookie flow verified via real login form)

seed_data_creation: Per-test TEST_ prefixed users, one restaurant, one driver_profile, one address row. Impersonation created no persistent data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_iter43_cookie_auth.py covers the P0 cookie migration surface. Register API requires field name='...' (NOT full_name). Public register only creates user_type=customer regardless of body. /businesses page in UI backs onto /api/search/featured — no /api/businesses endpoint exists. Address model requires user_id + street_address + state (NOT 'street'). Drivers/status body is {status:'online'} (NOT is_online). Driver going online requires admin approval — a 403 there still proves cookie auth reached the handler. Admin impersonation endpoint /api/admin/impersonate/{user_id} rotates the session_token cookie in place and /auth/me then returns the impersonated user.
rca of the issue: N/A — no defects. Migration verified: Bearer path unchanged for mobile; web relies on httpOnly cookie; placeholder 'cookie'/'null'/'undefined'/''/'bearer' Bearer headers correctly fall through to cookie via core._clean_token.
